name: unsafe fn align_to_mut < U > (& mut self) -> (& mut [T] , & mut [U] , & mut [T])
rule: The caller must ensure that the elements in the returned middle slice can safely be reinterpreted from `T` as `U`.
api: impl < T > [T] { unsafe fn align_to_mut < U > (& mut self) -> (& mut [T] , & mut [U] , & mut [T]) }
